ns2:course.label: Advanced Academic Writing I
ns2:course.description: Integration of the four skills of reading, writing, listening, and speaking; special focus on advanced academic writing at the graduate level, including writing such as proposals, research reports, theses, as appropriate; review of principles of writing including writing from sources. Credit may not be used toward a graduate degree. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: ESL 501, or recommendation from UIUC English as a Second Language Placement Test.
